21228.ins: Nylon is where the strong-elasticity claim earns its keep - the slim line holds through sitting and motion, and the open back converts a wardrobe basic into a statement piece without changing the front read. One size for 40-60 kg, as-pictured colorway.
21228.short: Open-back stretch slim leggings in nylon with strong elasticity, one size for 40-60 kg, outdoor-wearable statement piece.

21239.ins: Flower and heart split the difference between the romantic heart-only collars and the busier charm pieces - enough detail to read as designed, not so much as to clutter. Set black or set pink, matched pieces, leather base construction.
21239.short: Flower-and-heart leather collar set in set black or pink, matched pairs with romantic accents for lingerie and costume looks.

21240.ins: Blackout is the operative word against the sheer lace versions elsewhere in this category - this one fully blocks, which changes what it is for. Leather holds shape and wipes clean; the elastic band stretches to fit without hardware.
21240.short: Leather blackout eye mask with elastic band in black, pink or red, full light blocking, 27 x 7 cm wipe-clean construction.

21257.ins: The leather-wrapped handle is what separates a real tickler from a craft-shop feather, and the two styles differ only in length - 46 against 48 cm, a choice that matters more in use than it reads on screen. Polyester-and-leather build per the specs.
21257.short: Feather tickler with leather-wrapped handle in two styles, 46 and 48 cm, gentle sensory accessory, pick by length at order.

21269.ins: Cutout lace does what plain lace stockings do not - patterned negative space along the leg, which reads as design rather than sheer coverage. Polyester construction outlasts delicate hosiery, in red, white, or black for the standard outfit palettes.
21269.short: Romantic cutout lace socks in red, white or black polyester, decorative pattern hosiery for lingerie sets and costume finishing.

21351.ins: The heart lock reads as hardware without functioning as one - the balance this genre looks for, and the reason the design works on pink rather than the usual black. Adjustable through the standard 40-50 cm range on a real-leather band.
21351.short: Pink leather collar with heart lock accent, adjustable 40-50 cm circumference, hardware-inspired design in the sweetest colorway.

21355.ins: Red checkered leather is street-fashion reference rather than costume-shop stock - the collar that belongs with a wardrobe, and the vintage treatment keeps the red from reading bright. Adjustable through the standard 40-50 cm range.
21355.short: Harajuku red checkered leather choker with vintage street styling, adjustable 40-50 cm, collar for everyday wardrobe wear.

19837.ins: The garter belt does double duty in the outfit: it breaks the jumpsuit line at the hip and holds stockings when the look wants them - the reason a five-piece kit earns its count over the basic bunny sets. Red and black run the same construction, so the colorway is the only decision left.
19837.short: Five-piece polyester bunny set with headband, jumpsuit, bow tie, bracelet and garter belt in red or black, bust 70-110 cm for 40-60 kg.
